The demand is class B, family intent proven rather than per-cell volume proven, so each cell still has to pass the entity utility gate on its own data.

depth_is: true depth at a floor of 300
verdict: ADMIT. A FOURTH TRANSPORT PAIR MODE, and the most commercially valuable of the three.
decisive_evidence: Nearly every row names two real places, which is what separates a pair family from a category. athens to milos 700 at KD 1 and a 1.10 CPC; dubrovnik to hvar 350 at KD 0 and 1.20; hingham to boston 300 at KD 1 and 3.00; split to hvar 900 at KD 2 and 0.80; naples to positano 900 at KD 0 and 0.70. The geography is global: Greek islands, the Adriatic, the Amalfi coast, the Baltic, the Channel, the Irish Sea, Gibraltar, the Balearics, the Caribbean, Japan and Korea, Puget Sound and New England.
what_would_unlock_more: OpenStreetMap carries route=ferry relations under ODbL 1.0, the same licence the POI corpus already uses, and the transport graph builder already turns a route relation into node and edge records. This is the cheapest new pair mode to add and it is not built.

decisive_evidence: Dutch is the strongest and the Netherlands being a boating country is why: jachthaven naarden 1,100, kortenhoef 700, strijensas 500, bruinisse 450, nieuwboer 400, plus twelve more, almost all at KD 0. languages_measured: en, de, es, it, ja, pl, tr, nl, pt, fr
verdict: REFUSE IN ALL TEN LANGUAGES MEASURED. This is now a measurement rather than an extrapolation.
decisive_evidence: Supermarkets: 0 rows in de, pl, nl; 1 in tr; 2 in en, one of them resolving to the brand Publix and one where "in" is the state abbreviation for Indiana; pure near-me in it; an opening-hours question in es that places.city-opening already serves; and in ja the worst collision measured anywhere, the katakana prefix for super attaching to a bathhouse chain, a band, Dragon Ball, a motorcycle, the supermoon, the Super Bowl and the Rolex Submariner. Markets: weekend EVENT calendars in de and es, FINANCIAL markets in it, trade FAIRS in pl, the Rakuten Ichiba e-commerce brand and an eyewear chain in ja, and in tr a three-way collision where pazar also means Sunday.
what_would_unlock_more: Two families fall out of this and are worth their own measurement: a regional weekend-event calendar (German and Spanish) and a trade-fair calendar (Polish). Named food markets are real as ENTITIES in Japanese (Toyosu 26,000, Nishiki 11,000, Kuromon 9,800).
